sloka: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे शोणितौघपरिप्लुताः।ध्वजवर्मरथानश्वान्नानाप्रहरणानि च।आप्लुत्याप्लुत्य समरे राक्षसानां बभञ्जिरे ।। ६.९४.१३ ।।
transliteration: tataste vānarāḥ sarve śoṇitaughapariplutāḥ।dhvajavarmarathānaśvānnānāpraharaṇāni ca।āplutyāplutya samare rākṣasānāṁ babhañjire ।। 6.94.13 ।।

translations.english: Leaping and jumping the Vanaras and also the leaders of Vanaras bathed in blood broke all kinds of weapons, staff of chariots and the horses.
